title: Arithmetic Control of LLMs for Diverse User Preferences: Directional Preference Alignment with Multi-Objective Rewards

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the average response length and win rates using AlpacaEval-2.0 and a multi-objective reward model (evaluating helpfulness vs. verbosity) to demonstrate how Directional Preference Alignment can control the model's tendency to prefer overly long responses.
